deviations: --no-cache-dir added to the pip download phase: Brahms' SEC-02 sketch omits it, but a builder-run pip download without it would bake the HTTP/wheel cache under /home/builder/.cache/pip, defeating AC8 (the same reason PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR was scoped out of the runtime ENV in patch-3).
Wheelhouse created by the builder itself (mkdir in the download RUN) instead of a root RUN + chown - one less root-owned intermediate path; builder-owned and cleaned up by the root install phase.

'cd /' placed at script startup (all checks), not just before the Python checks: also stops non-Python tools (e.g. markdownlint config discovery) from resolving files relative to the repository; the Python checks additionally carry -I.

/home/builder contents changed vs the phase-1 review image: with builder creation moved before npm, useradd --create-home now finds no pre-existing /home/builder, so the Debian skeleton (.bashrc/.profile/.bash_logout, mode 700 home) is present (3 files/4553 bytes vs the phase-1 round's 4/0). Deterministic across builds of this Containerfile; AC8 holds; phase-1 counts superseded.

Requirements for the CI job definition round and P1-005; image-side controls (wheel-only pip, --ignore-scripts, hash locks, non-root runtime user) are in place.
